summary: Singularity Future Technology Ltd. filed an 8-K on June 22, 2026, reporting entry into an amended settlement agreement to resolve a securities class action. The aggregate cash settlement is $5,800,000, with $2,000,000 already in escrow; additional deposits of $1,500,000 within 15 days and $2,300,000 within 60 days are required. The settlement is subject to court approval and would dismiss the class action with prejudice. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation event is present; the filing concerns routine litigation settlement disclosure, thus categorized as None.
